sloka: ते शरीरम् विराधस्य भित्त्वा बर्हिण वाससः ।निपेतुः शोणिता दिग्धा धरण्याम् पावकोपमाः ॥३-३-१२॥
transliteration: te śarīram virādhasya bhittvā barhiṇa vāsasaḥ ।nipetuḥ śoṇitā digdhā dharaṇyām pāvakopamāḥ ॥3-3-12॥

translations.english: From his bow strung tight, Rama shot seven swift, goldenfeathered arrows comparable to Garuda and the Windgod in speed.
